title: GitHub Trending Summary - Daily - 2026-11-24
ranking_basis: GitHub Trending daily stars gained; supplied signal scores are secondary context.
ranking_explanation: Selected the 10 highest-gain non-fork, non-archived candidates from the supplied daily signals, ranked by daily Trending star gains descending; used signal score as secondary context. Verified every selected repository on GitHub Trending and via current GitHub REST API metadata and commit.
global_caveat: Star snapshot collection was unavailable because GitHub CLI authentication was not configured; delta_1d, delta_7d and delta_30d are null, not zero. Star totals are live REST API counts and may differ slightly from totals captured in the signals file. No Notable Shifts section is included because no usable prior-window comparison exists.

content.ranking_basis: GitHub Trending daily star gains; candidate scores used as attention context, with GitHub REST metadata/commit corroboration

sections.title: Headline
sections.content: Security-focused coding-agent skills lead the day, but the broader pattern is agents becoming more capable through workflows, software interfaces and external knowledge. A downloader, AI video editor and compact-model training project also posted large gains, showing the attention is not confined to agent frameworks.

sections.title: elementalsouls/Claude-BugHunter
sections.description: Bundled security-testing skills, slash commands and disclosed-vulnerability patterns for Claude Code.
sections.why_notable: Its 2,029-star daily gain leads the supplied candidates; its README describes an extensive, auditable red-team workflow.
sections.unique_caveat: GitHub star totals may have shifted slightly since the signal capture.

sections.title: Trending Technologies and Themes
sections.content:
- Coding-agent workflows and agent-native interfaces: The strongest cluster turns coding agents into repeatable workflows or gives them software interfaces: Claude-BugHunter (skills for security testing), obra/superpowers (composable development methodology), HKUDS/CLI-Anything (software exposed as agent-usable CLIs), cursor/plugins (plugin conventions), and google-labs-code/stitch-skills (design skills). Supporting repository sections: repo-01, repo-05, repo-08.
- Grounding agents in external information: firecrawl/firecrawl provides search/scraping and data access for agent context; mvanhorn/last30days-skill packages multi-source research and synthesis. Supporting repository sections: repo-03, repo-07.
- Accessible model training and inference: jingyaogong/minimind makes a compact from-scratch training pipeline approachable, while the listed repo signals overall include practical AI tooling rather than only model releases. Supporting repository sections: repo-06.
- AI-assisted media production: zhouxiaoka/autoclip targets automated long-to-short video editing, with subtitles, cover art and publishing copy. Supporting repository sections: repo-04.
- Focused utilities and compliance knowledge: XiaoYouChR/Ghost-Downloader-3 is a broad downloader, mjmirza/app-store-compliance turns rejection rules into a pre-submission playbook, and cathrynlavery/diagram-design packages a visual design system for agent-generated diagrams. Supporting repository sections: repo-02, repo-09, repo-10.

sections.title: Takeaway
sections.content: The clearest current bet is on making agents useful in concrete workflows: security testing, software operation, development process and information gathering. High gains for a downloader, video editor and small-model training project add breadth, while absent historical snapshots mean this is a one-day attention read rather than evidence of sustained growth beyond the four reported trending days.

sections.title: Sources and Method
sections.content: GitHub Trending daily and supplied deterministic attention signals supplied window gains and ranks; all 10 listed projects were verified against GitHub REST repository metadata and default-branch commit endpoints. Snapshot-delta retrieval failed because gh authentication was unavailable, so all snapshot deltas are null, not zero.
